newsitem.title: PANAMA: PANAMA Q1 GREW 3.7 PCT YEAR-ON-YEAR - PRESIDENT.
newsitem.headline: PANAMA Q1 GREW 3.7 PCT YEAR-ON-YEAR - PRESIDENT.

text.p: Panama's gross domestic product grew 3.7 percent in real terms in the first quarter of 1997 compared to the first quarter of 1996, President Ernesto Perez Balladares said on Wednesday.
"The (GDP) growth was 3.7 percent, and that is very good," Balladares said in his weekly national radio address.

Previously, the Ministry of Planning and Economic Policy had published preliminary estimates for first-quarter 1997 GDP growth of 3.6 percent. Ministry officials said it was the first time such figures had been released and no comparative figure was available for 1996.

Balladares said the major factors for the first-quarter growth were greater confidence in the Panamanian economy and "the privatisation of some state firms, a favourable restructuring of the public debt, and healthy but aggressive investments in infrastructure".
